commands.description: the CLI text to stage on top of the collected configuration: one string (lines separated by newlines) or an array of lines, joined with newlines. Give exactly one of commands or config

config.description: the WHOLE replacement configuration of the device (the "config file" option; at most 2 MB; stored unchecked, not validated). Give exactly one of commands or config

action.description: inject or modify: stage an advertisement (next_hop required); withdraw: stage the loss of a received one (device, vrf, external_peer, prefix only); restore: drop what is staged for the key. type is the peer type (EBGP or IBGP), not the action

firewall_rules.description: firewall rule changes to stage: {op: add|remove|edit|move|discard, device, scope_id (default LOCAL), rulebase_id (default PRIMARY), predecessor (add: the rule to go after; move: after this rule, empty = first), rule_id (remove, edit, move, discard), rule (add, edit: the rule's WHOLE definition: name, action, enabled, sourceZones, destinationZones, sourceAddresses, destinationAddresses, sourceUsers, applications, services)}; discard drops a rule's staged add, edit, move or removal

change_set_id.description: an EXISTING change set to act on with lifecycle (instead of creating one)

op.description: rename: lifecycle.name and/or description; duplicate: copy it (lifecycle.name optional); delete: confirm = the change set id; discard_device: throw away that device's uncommitted edits (lifecycle.device); restore_commit: make an earlier version current (lifecycle.commit_id); predict: start a prediction of the change set and return the predicted snapshot id at once, without waiting (wait with fwdctl wait snapshot); add_check: attach a check this change set carries (lifecycle.check; name optional, none for NQE), run by Forward on the base; edit_check: lifecycle.check_id with a new name and/or a whole new definition; remove_check: lifecycle.check_id

check.description: a change-set check: Isolation, Reachability or Existential (an intent check: filters is a path query as in path search, optional noise_types and header_fields_with_defaults, return_path ANY or SYMMETRIC for Existential only) or NQE (query_id of a library query, optional params)

return_path.description: Existential only. SYMMETRIC was measured (by a colleague, on one build) to be accepted and stored but not asserted: to assert symmetry add one check per direction

lifecycle.description: needs change_set_id; does not combine with devices, bgp_advertisements, firewall_rules, snapshot_id or run

confirm.description: lifecycle delete: the change set id again
